summary:

- Improved Player Profile avatar in SettingsDialog to display decoded Google Play Games profile images via PlayGamesAvatarClient with a cohesive dark/amber fallback icon when unavailable, loading, or offline
- Added localized strings (en, pt, es, de) and unit/widget tests in settings_account_wipe_and_avatar_test.dart and play_games_service_test.dart
